_comment: Atlas Growth :: RECOVERY pass over excluded_officp.csv (RUN-PLAN 4.2 step 2). The main config deliberately refuses the generic contractor buckets because they flood. This pass takes them back ONLY when the business NAME says foundation work — the pairing that qualify-leads.js cannot express as a single rule. Deterministic, $0, no re-scrape.

qualify_rules._r: Broadened beyond the plan's original 'concrete contractor' only: a real foundation firm typed just 'Contractor' or 'Construction company' was being dropped as not_in_icp with no way back. Same name gate, wider type net.
qualify_rules.label: not_generic_contractor

qualify_rules._r: The name must actually claim foundation/leveling work. This is the precision half of the pair — keep it strict.
qualify_rules.label: name_not_foundation

qualify_rules._r: Same size floor as the main pass so the recovery cannot sneak sub-floor rows in.
qualify_rules.label: too_small
